_comment: GPU regression guard: arm a = the previous release (e.g. v0.1.7), arm b = the candidate, both with their default GPU profile. There is no GPU scheduling change to measure between v0.1.7 and 0.1.8-dev (kGpuDecodeLatencyTarget 12, predictive off in both; dynalm/src/runtime/engine.h); the GPU-side differences for a dense model on Metal are the graph-cache LRU and 1 GiB workspace cap (dynacore/src/gpu/ggml_device.cpp) and KV sizing within the Metal working set (dynalm/src/runtime/engine.cpp). So the gates claim no improvement: they check that nothing regresses and that single-user speed is equivalent. Verdicts need a 95% CI (require_ci) and >= 4 pairs; run tools/bench/ab.sh with --sessions 2 --rounds 4 --warmup-rounds 1 (8 pairs per point). expected_exe is filled from DIR/expected_exe.json by tools/bench/e2e.sh.
